evidence.quote: However, we have not yet explored how to amortize this iterative optimization into the base model.

A promising yet underexplored direction is to distill CSE’s evolution trajectories into RL-style training (Yu et al., 2025; Zheng et al., 2025; Jiang et al., 2025) signals to strengthen the base model, enabling comparable or better optimization and producing higher-quality solutions.
